_comment: Single source of truth for the reactor-slot CFD case. Edit values here, then run setup_case.py. SI units.

geometry._comment: Half of one catalyst slot (symmetry plane at y = 0). Bed thickness = 2 x bed_half_thickness.

gas._comment: H2/CO2 = 3 mixture at 320 C, 3 MPa. k_eff is the EFFECTIVE bed conductivity (gas + particles), entered through Pr.

bed._comment: Ergun coefficients are computed from particle size and porosity. Bulk density from MSE measurement.

reaction._comment: Heat source = 1-D model profile q_ref(x) at T_ref, corrected every chunk by exact Arrhenius using each zone's temperature (n_zones axial x n_radial_bands).

control._comment: PI(D) controller: manipulates coolant temperature to hold the volume-average bed temperature at the setpoint.
